text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"King"—namely, the title of a monarch. It 
refers to the supreme sovereign of a 
single nation or people.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That is how a standard dictionary defines 
it. However, in her dictionary— there is 
only one single meaning recorded.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —What is a “King”? Namely, it is I.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Discard all other writings. Or burn them 
to ash. Or else—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Cover it all over in the name of the great 
Orfevre!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Orfevre. In the realm over which she 
reigns, there can only ever be one king.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Shortly after signing the contract to 
become Orfevre's trainer and having her 
Make a Debut date set—

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
You're... Orfevre-san's trainer, right? 
Thank you for taking the time for our 
interview today!
choice_data_list: I-I look forward to working with you!

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
By the way, getting straight to the 
point... ...where might Orfevre-san be?

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Retainer A
text_block_list.text:
You there, sir! Make way for the "King"! 
Please step aside!

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text: ...!? W-What's going on...!?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
choice_data_list: Orfe! Where have you been all this time—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: You.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Do you dare speak to the King?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Radiating from eyes that shine like jewels 
is pure fury— her sheer intensity makes me 
flinch instinctively. The aura emanating 
from her is tremendous.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text: K-King...?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"...Man. You are the PR person for this 
occasion, correct?"

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Ah, no, I'm a reporter, not public 
relations—... 'this time around'?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
By royal decree. Make My path of 
supremacy, which begins here and now, 
known to all.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: For the sake of the ignorant masses.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text: T... U-Um, Trainer, do you have a second?

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Um, what do you mean by 'king'? And what's 
this about 'common folk'...? I don't 
really understand...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: It means exactly what it sounds like.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Hello, Trainer-san. I apologize for 
interrupting so suddenly.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She is Dream Journey. A premier, top-tier 
Umamusume of incredible skill, having 
conquered both the Takarazuka Kinen and 
Arima Kinen last year.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And— she is also Orfevre's older sister by 
blood.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The press coming to interview Orfevre 
before her debut was entirely thanks to 
her older sister.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Um, Journey-san. What did you mean by what 
you just said...?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
My younger sister, Orfevre... is a born 
ruler.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...No, let me rephrase that. They are a 
chosen existence, endowed with the caliber 
of a king.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text: Uh—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh. It seems you understand right 
away."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
The sky is high and clear today. The very 
wind she loves is blowing—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Someone.

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Retainer B
text_block_list.text:
! ...All personnel, take your starting 
positions! —Begin the race!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A completely unplanned street race had 
suddenly begun. But my surprise was 
quickly overwritten by another shock 
altogether—

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Retainer B
text_block_list.text:
"Lady Orfe...! Forgive my insolence before 
your presence, but I will not let you 
pass...!"

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: I see. —Then, let us conquer.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: "—Hmph...! Haaaaaaaaaah!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her subjects ahead... Orfevre forcefully 
smashes right through their sturdy wall. 
In the blink of an eye, she takes the 
lead, continuing to accelerate—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Hahaha...! —Even the wind cannot 
keep up!

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
...! S-So strong...! What in the world... 
Th-this is...!

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text: ! I see, so this is... a king...!!

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
—Orfevre-san! That was a magnificent 
run...!

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
"...I've made up my mind! I was planning 
to publish this together with the other 
pre-debut Umamusume, but..."

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
I'll talk to the editor-in-chief and get a 
full page! Dedicated entirely to 
introducing Orfevre-san! Please let our 
magazine feature you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Since an Umamusume's true abilities are 
unknown before her debut, they're usually 
treated equally. To receive this kind of 
treatment among them... is proof of the 
massive expectations placed on her talent.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ... Utterly nonsensical.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text: Huh.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: It seems you cannot see it.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: These three crowns above my head.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text: ! Does that mean...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Classic Triple Crown... Consisting of 
the Satsuki Sho, the Nippon Derby, and the 
Kikuka Sho, it is the pinnacle of glory 
one can attain in the Classic division.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the past, six of the strongest 
Umamusume, including Symboli Rudolf and 
Narita Brian, have claimed it.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
—So you intend to "take on" the Classic 
Triple Crown...!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...You continue to pile folly upon folly?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Challenge? Nay, I am reclaiming it. That 
has long belonged to me.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
I-It's the Classic Triple Crown, you 
know?! It's not that easy to—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Tedious.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Drawing what belongs to you toward 
yourself. What is so difficult about that?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Its difficulty is proven by the fact that 
only six Uma Musume have ever achieved it 
in all of history. But to her—it was 
simply her destiny.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: "...That's enough about PR. Begone."

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? ...Does that mean the interview is 
over!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Chasing after her in a panic alongside the 
reporter... we found Orfevre with her 
older sister. It seems she was trying to 
hold her back, but...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"I was just speaking with Orfevre, you 
see. Would you permit me to lend a small 
hand as well?"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Yes. As a way to give Orfe more publicity, 
I thought bringing up my name—being 
currently active and buzzed-about—might 
work.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but... is my background not convincing 
enough?

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
N-No, no! For someone as amazing as 
you...! We should be the ones begging you 
to be on the cover!
choice_data_list:
Ah! How about... the two of us on the 
cover together?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
First and foremost, this is a massive 
opportunity that is normally never given 
to a Junior-class Umamusume. I believe 
even Orfevre would agree.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I see. It's almost too much to ask... but 
if given the opportunity, I would be truly 
fortunate.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
What do you think, Or? It will serve as a 
memento with you... and it makes me happy, 
too.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ... In that case, you are forgiven.
choice_data_list: Um, what do you think, reporter...?

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Personally, I couldn't ask for anything 
better! I'll go check with the higher-up—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Confirm?

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text: On the cover! I'll gladly do it!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The interview continued. Watching Orfevre 
calmly proceed with the photo shoot, only 
one thought comes to mind...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Both before Orfevre appeared and even 
now... I've constantly been on the back 
foot, making an utterly pathetic showing 
as a trainer. I can't keep going on like 
this.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I firmly clench my trembling right 
hand. The pain engraved upon it is a vow 
of fealty to the King—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"...Receive this. The wind stirred up by 
one who feeds on your dreams and strives 
to become the "King." It is my power."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Etch this into your soul forever, and 
strive onward. —So that one day, you may 
stand alongside me.
choice_data_list: (I'll become a trainer worthy of a king!)

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
—You wish to learn about Orfevre... from 
me?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I want to be of help to Orfevre, just like 
Dream Journey. There's no time until her 
debut—I must learn as quickly as possible—
choice_data_list:
So not a shred of doubt remains on the 
King's path to supremacy!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
She really is such an honest and upfront 
person.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Of course, if there is anything I 
can do, I would be more than happy to 
help.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Indeed. First of all...—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: —Well, Orfe? How's today's tea?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"...It's bitter. Not like you at all, 
Sister."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, well, it's because... Orfe's Trainer 
brewed it, after all.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...How tasteless.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Even so, it seems... you've taken 
quite a liking to her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"—And stand together with you at the 
pinnacle!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"—And stand together with you at the 
pinnacle!"

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Those are good eyes. Blazing with fiery 
spirit... It was quite a spectacle.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Will you become my staff, or remain a 
clown...? Entertain me as best you can.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Success is a certainty. Therefore, a 
little amusement would do no harm.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the Twinkle Series— Our path of 
conquest alongside Orfevre begins.
